one_liner: Document parsing API that turns invoices, receipts, and purchase orders into clean JSON at 99.2% field accuracy.
description: DocParse is a layout-aware document parsing API for financial operations documents. It extracts line items, totals, tax fields, and vendor data from invoices, receipts, and purchase orders into structured JSON, with per-field confidence scores and an optional human-review fallback below a configurable threshold. Designed for AP automation and ERP integration workloads at volume.
target_user: Engineering teams building AP automation and back-office document workflows

icp.who: Engineers at fintechs, ERPs, and AP-automation vendors processing 10k-10M documents a month
icp.pain: Generic OCR breaks on layout variety, and cloud-vendor document AI needs weeks of tuning per document type to reach production accuracy
icp.buying_trigger: An AP-automation feature commitment with an accuracy SLA that in-house OCR pipelines keep missing

differentiators: 99.2% field-level accuracy on a 5,000-document invoice benchmark, methodology published
Per-field confidence scores with human-in-the-loop fallback below your threshold
p95 latency of 1.8 seconds per page at any volume tier
